finalText:
**Build passes now.** Two real bugs hid in the warning wall.

`resolveRetries` read `options.retries`, but the bump renamed it `retryCount`. It now takes either. See [src/core/options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6).

`isBackoffEnabled` threw on an unset flag. The new loader gives `undefined`, not `false`. Unset now means disabled, as before. See [src/net/retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7).

The 8 warnings left are real deprecations. `Buffer()`, `punycode`, `crypto.createCipher`, and 5 more.

Next: clear those deprecations if you want a silent log.
